00f7f6605d26cc104595e6a1f36b810567ea738c.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
00f7f6605d26cc104595e6a1f36b810567ea738c.label: has process
00f7f6605d26cc104595e6a1f36b810567ea738c.name: has_process

048b9f8057ace3112bfb5d8d20a15a9f3f5ff55a.definition: A reference to the unit of measure of a `QuantifiableProperty` of interest, such as `DEG_C`.
048b9f8057ace3112bfb5d8d20a15a9f3f5ff55a.label: has unit
048b9f8057ace3112bfb5d8d20a15a9f3f5ff55a.name: has_unit

09d1516989161c88147f0f11caa83779d1aade77.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Property` being observed by a `Sensor` with the `EnumerationKind-Substance` it characterizes within a specific `Substance-Medium`. For example, to denote the concentration of a `EnumerationKind-Substance` in a `Substance-Medium`, `ofSubstance` is used. Typically, there is also an `ofMedium` relation between the observed `Property` and the `Substance-Medium` (see Figures 10-9 and 10-10). For example, to represent the concentration of CO2 in air, we use `ofSubstance` to relate to CO2 and `ofMedium` to relate to air. The term `ofSubstance` is broad enough to include situations where a sensor is used to detect constituents that should not be present in a medium, such as ammonia in air. Therefore, `ofSubstance` is used to indicate the substance of interest, while `ofConstituent` would indicate a constituent that is normally present in the composition of the mix.
09d1516989161c88147f0f11caa83779d1aade77.label: of substance
09d1516989161c88147f0f11caa83779d1aade77.name: of_substance

0acfe4eec0b5dd3f0841894cbaa2016f8f1731d1.definition: The `hasDropRate` relation is used to link to a `Property` describes the amount of data points lost within a range of time due to latencies or other factors.
0acfe4eec0b5dd3f0841894cbaa2016f8f1731d1.label: has drop rate
0acfe4eec0b5dd3f0841894cbaa2016f8f1731d1.name: has_drop_rate

0f0d600adc36a365d8623c61f4ddf7ac34afdd3a.definition: The `hasOptionalConnectionPoint` relation means that the `ConnectionPoint` is optional and is not required to be connected. The presence of this relation is used to indicate that such a "dangling connection point" should not generate a validation error in an integrated or non-integrated context.
0f0d600adc36a365d8623c61f4ddf7ac34afdd3a.label: has optional connection point
0f0d600adc36a365d8623c61f4ddf7ac34afdd3a.name: has_optional_connection_point

0f52f189700ddf510f4dec33e869a11ac6647e78.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Concept` with a `Property`.
0f52f189700ddf510f4dec33e869a11ac6647e78.label: has property
0f52f189700ddf510f4dec33e869a11ac6647e78.name: has_property

147f96b500333ecbd7e72481ca940df866d9c8db.definition: The `hasProcessedData` relation is used to link to a `Property` that describes any data processing, filtering, or transformation applied to the raw measurement values.
147f96b500333ecbd7e72481ca940df866d9c8db.label: has processed data
147f96b500333ecbd7e72481ca940df866d9c8db.name: has_processed_data

1934a8ae53ec80a8ccbe236831d7386b37f22efc.definition:
A `Relation` that associates a `Property` with another equivalent `Property`. For example, a `Property` that represents a `Zone`
temperature could have one or more `hasInternalReference` relations to another `Property` that is a temperature measurement from one room in the zone (see Figure 11-2).

![Zone Internal Reference.](figures/Figure_11-2_Zone_Internal_Reference.svg)

Another use of `hasInternalReference` is to make a `Property` of a piece of equipment
visible as a `Property` of a piece of containing equipment.
This is illustrated in Figure 11-3.

![Equipment Containment.](figures/Figure_11-3_Equipment_Contains_3.svg)

Note that the `hasInternalReference` relation is transitive.
1934a8ae53ec80a8ccbe236831d7386b37f22efc.label: has internal reference
1934a8ae53ec80a8ccbe236831d7386b37f22efc.name: has_internal_reference

1aebd3c8a7e57760d878c5cd5bae650a92cfa34f.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
1aebd3c8a7e57760d878c5cd5bae650a92cfa34f.label: has process
1aebd3c8a7e57760d878c5cd5bae650a92cfa34f.name: has_process

1b6a1f7f781290d7332f0342bb424402492b468e.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
1b6a1f7f781290d7332f0342bb424402492b468e.label: has process
1b6a1f7f781290d7332f0342bb424402492b468e.name: has_process

1ef816c982b8418531c3f3a3d5557b8c44f36800.definition: A `Relation` that associates adjacent entities in a connection path, comprised of `Equipment`-`ConnectionPoint`-`Connection`-`ConnectionPoint`-`Equipment` sequences.
1ef816c982b8418531c3f3a3d5557b8c44f36800.label: cnx
1ef816c982b8418531c3f3a3d5557b8c44f36800.name: cnx

208b552721d490530a82b26fc541f4ee37e3f99a.definition: The `hasTemporalResolution` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the minimum time interval between successive measurements or data points.
208b552721d490530a82b26fc541f4ee37e3f99a.label: has temporal resolution
208b552721d490530a82b26fc541f4ee37e3f99a.name: has_temporal_resolution

23cc85eebcc09707813a90ff6b1d5ce0d2eaff65.definition: The relation `connectedFrom` indicates that connectable things are `connected` with a specific direction of flow. B is `connectedFrom` A, means that the direction of flow is from A to B.  The inverse direction is indicated by `connectedTo` (see {s223:connectedTo}).
23cc85eebcc09707813a90ff6b1d5ce0d2eaff65.label: connected from
23cc85eebcc09707813a90ff6b1d5ce0d2eaff65.name: connected_from

2b2fd8673b442f66d7ad888fcdf8411eb16c2a67.definition: The `hasMeasurementRange` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the expected range of variation that can physically be measured, e.g. by a sensor.
2b2fd8673b442f66d7ad888fcdf8411eb16c2a67.label: has measurement range
2b2fd8673b442f66d7ad888fcdf8411eb16c2a67.name: has_measurement_range

2d5c748e640366b603e66d5b8c25189161b14301.definition: A `Relation` that associates a role with of a piece of `Equipment`, a `Connection`, `ConnectionPoint`, or `System` within a building (e.g., a heating coil might be associated with `Role-Heating`). Possible values are defined in `EnumerationKind-Role` (see {s223:EnumerationKind-Role}).
2d5c748e640366b603e66d5b8c25189161b14301.label: has role
2d5c748e640366b603e66d5b8c25189161b14301.name: has_role

34186346ac0e1397814b859b059eddde174e2137.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Property` with the specific Medium it describes. A `Property` corresponding to the temperature of a medium would be associated with this medium using the relation `ofMedium`.
34186346ac0e1397814b859b059eddde174e2137.label: of medium
34186346ac0e1397814b859b059eddde174e2137.name: of_medium

3b7ae79864b03daffd22e3598f32d36fe9116b67.definition: A `Relation` that associates a threshold with the `QuantifiableProperty` indicating a specific value at which an action may be taken, distinguished from an offset or a range.
3b7ae79864b03daffd22e3598f32d36fe9116b67.label: has threshold
3b7ae79864b03daffd22e3598f32d36fe9116b67.name: has_threshold

4c1bf8b724b95e4996b0a40466c4aae5fda6a45b.definition: The relation `connected` indicates that two connectable things are `connected` without regard to the direction of flow.
4c1bf8b724b95e4996b0a40466c4aae5fda6a45b.label: connected
4c1bf8b724b95e4996b0a40466c4aae5fda6a45b.name: connected

5699d39e0d6d7a81566eaea594863d7118ffd27d.definition: The relation `hasMedium` is used to indicate what medium is flowing through the connection (e.g., air, water, electricity). The possible values are defined in `Substance-Medium` (see {s223:Substance-Medium}).
5699d39e0d6d7a81566eaea594863d7118ffd27d.label: has medium
5699d39e0d6d7a81566eaea594863d7118ffd27d.name: medium

58b0ec7ec2c7b9628950e4ce1f767dad6d3b3534.definition: Associates a piece of equipment or a system with the treatment objective it is intended to achieve. What it does to achieve that is watr:hasProcess.
58b0ec7ec2c7b9628950e4ce1f767dad6d3b3534.label: has treatment objective
58b0ec7ec2c7b9628950e4ce1f767dad6d3b3534.name: has_treatment_objective

590c9346cf82540000ce7e3f9a2bfc2203cacc94.definition: The relation `connectedFrom` indicates that connectable things are `connected` with a specific direction of flow. B is `connectedFrom` A, means that the direction of flow is from A to B.  The inverse direction is indicated by `connectedTo` (see {s223:connectedTo}).
590c9346cf82540000ce7e3f9a2bfc2203cacc94.label: connected from
590c9346cf82540000ce7e3f9a2bfc2203cacc94.name: connected_from

5abe99e9199e334cd5bfbe506969d2c532641d2c.definition: A reference to the `QuantityKind` of a `QuantifiableProperty` of interest, such as `Temperature`.
5abe99e9199e334cd5bfbe506969d2c532641d2c.label: has quantity kind
5abe99e9199e334cd5bfbe506969d2c532641d2c.name: has_quantity_kind

5f61f26f9dc4754cb2deaf424f057a097235608d.definition: A `Relation` that associates a role with of a piece of `Equipment`, a `Connection`, `ConnectionPoint`, or `System` within a building (e.g., a heating coil might be associated with `Role-Heating`). Possible values are defined in `EnumerationKind-Role` (see {s223:EnumerationKind-Role}).
5f61f26f9dc4754cb2deaf424f057a097235608d.label: has role
5f61f26f9dc4754cb2deaf424f057a097235608d.name: has_role

6003e2f31a5913b65e721fb0c84d295f6571a312.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Property` that characterizes a `Medium-Mix` with one of the constituents of that mix (e.g., `Fluid-Water` `composedOf` `Property` `ofConstituent` `Constituent-H2O`).
6003e2f31a5913b65e721fb0c84d295f6571a312.label: of constituent
6003e2f31a5913b65e721fb0c84d295f6571a312.name: of_constituent

62fbf546c7f47073b55574a021220f9690ac4f1d.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Property` with an external telemetry source.
62fbf546c7f47073b55574a021220f9690ac4f1d.label: has external reference
62fbf546c7f47073b55574a021220f9690ac4f1d.name: has_external_reference

64fd457ed6571e87b59a931ecbd4bdd88ae6aeff.definition: `hasAspect` is used to establish the context of a `Property`. The value must be an instance of `EnumerationKind`. For example, if a `Property` has a temperature value of 45.3, the `hasAspect` relation is used to state what that represents, such as a temperature limit during working hours, etc. A `Property` can have any number of `hasAspect` relations as needed to establish the context.
64fd457ed6571e87b59a931ecbd4bdd88ae6aeff.label: has aspect
64fd457ed6571e87b59a931ecbd4bdd88ae6aeff.name: has_aspect

6c18fc6e407f059edc2fcfdb97e39c8267b895a9.definition: The `hasVariableRange` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the expected range of variation for the measured variable under normal operating conditions.
6c18fc6e407f059edc2fcfdb97e39c8267b895a9.label: has variable range
6c18fc6e407f059edc2fcfdb97e39c8267b895a9.name: has_variable_range

71af2a8cf5d560d30fe98f90bbc2e5ebdf54debd.definition: The `hasAccuracy` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the maximum expected deviation between the measured value and the true value in engineering units.
71af2a8cf5d560d30fe98f90bbc2e5ebdf54debd.label: has accuracy
71af2a8cf5d560d30fe98f90bbc2e5ebdf54debd.name: has_accuracy

73576e317b36719983c36274267aeed39de9ec65.definition: A `Relation` that associates a role with of a piece of `Equipment`, a `Connection`, `ConnectionPoint`, or `System` within a building (e.g., a heating coil might be associated with `Role-Heating`). Possible values are defined in `EnumerationKind-Role` (see {s223:EnumerationKind-Role}).
73576e317b36719983c36274267aeed39de9ec65.label: has role
73576e317b36719983c36274267aeed39de9ec65.name: has_role

77de882f4877925762ada1d6d0b7025c1d1e67b4.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
77de882f4877925762ada1d6d0b7025c1d1e67b4.label: has process
77de882f4877925762ada1d6d0b7025c1d1e67b4.name: has_process

7a5c240fa5adf9f31aaae8830c59347e400ab75c.definition: A `Relation` that associates a piece of `Equipment` with its component pieces of `Equipment`, or a `PhysicalSpace` (see {s223:PhysicalSpace}) with its component `PhysicalSpace`s.
7a5c240fa5adf9f31aaae8830c59347e400ab75c.label: contains
7a5c240fa5adf9f31aaae8830c59347e400ab75c.name: contains_

7bf48178bd1efa822698fb565698cacb4d21651f.definition: A `Relation` that associates a role with of a piece of `Equipment`, a `Connection`, `ConnectionPoint`, or `System` within a building (e.g., a heating coil might be associated with `Role-Heating`). Possible values are defined in `EnumerationKind-Role` (see {s223:EnumerationKind-Role}).
7bf48178bd1efa822698fb565698cacb4d21651f.label: has role
7bf48178bd1efa822698fb565698cacb4d21651f.name: has_role

8105c4d82e6380b318a744ad5e74689461343388.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Concept` with a `Property`.
8105c4d82e6380b318a744ad5e74689461343388.label: has property
8105c4d82e6380b318a744ad5e74689461343388.name: has_property

8451dabd9e2ded9147b8a2b2e3da3ce8b178f086.definition: The `hasResponseTime` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the time required for the sensor or measurement system to respond to a step change in the measured variable.
8451dabd9e2ded9147b8a2b2e3da3ce8b178f086.label: has response time
8451dabd9e2ded9147b8a2b2e3da3ce8b178f086.name: has_response_time

85f3b41b85cb451799e447cef7bf1bb307dce8bd.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Controller` (see {s223:Controller}) with the `Function`s (see {s223:Function}) that it executes.
85f3b41b85cb451799e447cef7bf1bb307dce8bd.label: executes
85f3b41b85cb451799e447cef7bf1bb307dce8bd.name: executes

8b90b473899dd30c5724a4d456c068d635dc0350.definition: A `Relation` that associates something with a fixed value, as opposed to a computed, measured, or externally derived value.
8b90b473899dd30c5724a4d456c068d635dc0350.label: has value
8b90b473899dd30c5724a4d456c068d635dc0350.name: has_value

8c75ee3c2a820dc12579262fd4229b84763566a8.definition: Associates a piece of equipment or a system with the treatment objective it is intended to achieve. What it does to achieve that is watr:hasProcess.
8c75ee3c2a820dc12579262fd4229b84763566a8.label: has treatment objective
8c75ee3c2a820dc12579262fd4229b84763566a8.name: has_treatment_objective

8e9c7b71cbaa481c4ca8f6e136227574486cbfbf.definition: The `hasBias` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the systematic offset or drift in measurements relative to the true value.
8e9c7b71cbaa481c4ca8f6e136227574486cbfbf.label: has bias
8e9c7b71cbaa481c4ca8f6e136227574486cbfbf.name: has_bias

8f8fa11ff746505b6453da0767199c69845c9dc8.definition: Associates a piece of equipment or a system with the treatment objective it is intended to achieve. What it does to achieve that is watr:hasProcess.
8f8fa11ff746505b6453da0767199c69845c9dc8.label: has treatment objective
8f8fa11ff746505b6453da0767199c69845c9dc8.name: has_treatment_objective

952325f51726e8072b27f9f01491ee84f54dbcf3.definition:
A `Relation` that associates a piece of `Equipment` with the `ActuatableProperty` that it responds to. If the `Equipment`
is an `Actuator` (a subclass of `Equipment`), `actuatedByProperty` is a required relation. An `Actuator` may also identify another piece of
`Equipment` being actuated (see {s223:actuates}).
952325f51726e8072b27f9f01491ee84f54dbcf3.label: actuated by property
952325f51726e8072b27f9f01491ee84f54dbcf3.name: actuated_by_property

968561bafd0be9f40174179c3792ab37d8661ab2.definition: This relation binds a control setpoint to the `QuantifiableProperty` indicating the range of values within which a sensed variable can vary without indicating a condition has changed.
968561bafd0be9f40174179c3792ab37d8661ab2.label: has deadband
968561bafd0be9f40174179c3792ab37d8661ab2.name: has_deadband

97712b59b02a5ed5602e65147865a0730bfb43ad.definition: A `Relation` that associates a piece of `Equipment` with its physical location (i.e., in a `PhysicalSpace`). The physical location of a piece of `Equipment` is not necessarily the same as the location affected by the operation of the `Equipment`. For example, an air handler may physically be located on the roof, but its effect is to provide conditioned air to a `Zone` or `DomainSpace` within the building. By following the path of connections, it can be determined what other equipment or spaces are possibly impacted by the `Equipment`.
97712b59b02a5ed5602e65147865a0730bfb43ad.label: has physical location
97712b59b02a5ed5602e65147865a0730bfb43ad.name: has_physical_location

a05dc0a6213ec6b675e99fb9a55b56fcb7d9aeec.definition: A `Relation` that associates an `EnumerableProperty` that describes an Alarm or Status with a `QuantifiableProperty`.
a05dc0a6213ec6b675e99fb9a55b56fcb7d9aeec.label: has alarm status
a05dc0a6213ec6b675e99fb9a55b56fcb7d9aeec.name: has_alarm_status

a97b6497c67c265d08b720a2ad47312ce27063b2.definition: Associates a piece of equipment or a system with the treatment objective it is intended to achieve. What it does to achieve that is watr:hasProcess.
a97b6497c67c265d08b720a2ad47312ce27063b2.label: has treatment objective
a97b6497c67c265d08b720a2ad47312ce27063b2.name: has_treatment_objective

aad4a773eee0fdfdb1543077070368643062c7f6.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Concept` with a `Property`.
aad4a773eee0fdfdb1543077070368643062c7f6.label: has property
aad4a773eee0fdfdb1543077070368643062c7f6.name: has_property

abed517f27c504a823cf202ca4eba3718212aa9d.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
abed517f27c504a823cf202ca4eba3718212aa9d.label: has process
abed517f27c504a823cf202ca4eba3718212aa9d.name: has_process

abf6453c4c59c9ec0fc324411907880256830ad7.definition: The `hasCalibrationCurve` relation is used to link to a `Property` that describes the mathematical relationship or lookup table between raw sensor output and calibrated engineering units.
abf6453c4c59c9ec0fc324411907880256830ad7.label: has calibration curve
abf6453c4c59c9ec0fc324411907880256830ad7.name: has_calibration_curve

afde5f944dfa666fea093999aef2593d8c108b43.definition: The `hasNumericRange` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the span between the minimum and maximum measurable values in engineering units.
afde5f944dfa666fea093999aef2593d8c108b43.label: has numeric range
afde5f944dfa666fea093999aef2593d8c108b43.name: has_numeric_range

b89f7cd7ac9fa79724557fb53eb381277af043b8.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Connectable` with a `Connection`, without regard to the direction of flow. It is used to discover what connection links two connectable things.
b89f7cd7ac9fa79724557fb53eb381277af043b8.label: connected through
b89f7cd7ac9fa79724557fb53eb381277af043b8.name: connected_through

bc6490b8ce3188f8dbe90c4e6d90e5355f4593c6.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
bc6490b8ce3188f8dbe90c4e6d90e5355f4593c6.label: has process
bc6490b8ce3188f8dbe90c4e6d90e5355f4593c6.name: has_process

bee0135c20e01ca8c225e9da8e4197214cd560aa.label: has aggregation
bee0135c20e01ca8c225e9da8e4197214cd560aa.name: has_aggregation

c7e0be1b0ba6a6e8cfb54a33b233d851cbe2c913.definition: The `hasPrecision` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the repeatability or reproducibility of measurements under identical conditions.
c7e0be1b0ba6a6e8cfb54a33b233d851cbe2c913.label: has precision
c7e0be1b0ba6a6e8cfb54a33b233d851cbe2c913.name: has_precision

c91b245b22c435c303ba8aeb12019782868c38b8.name: cnx

d02becc7c7a48ab0101add13be91507ef1293f3c.name: has_process

d07c4f2d22682892d62390f8bbea78676cfc7664.definition: One of two `Relation`s that associates `Connectable` with a `ConnectionPoint`. It is the inverse of the relation `isConnectionPointOf` (see {s223:isConnectionPointOf}).
d07c4f2d22682892d62390f8bbea78676cfc7664.label: has connection point
d07c4f2d22682892d62390f8bbea78676cfc7664.name: has_connection_point

d7d8f6f8c9109ab866f7bbd118eed120e32e2c74.definition: The relation `connectedTo` indicates that connectable things are `connected` with a specific direction of flow. A is `connectedTo` B, means a direction of flow from A to B.  The inverse direction is indicated by `connectedFrom` (see {s223:connectedFrom}).
d7d8f6f8c9109ab866f7bbd118eed120e32e2c74.label: connected to
d7d8f6f8c9109ab866f7bbd118eed120e32e2c74.name: connected_to

e0af2845e17c376cee0a0e8055d2fa4d9cd479ad.definition: One of two `Relation`s that associates `Connectable` with a `ConnectionPoint`. It is the inverse of the relation `isConnectionPointOf` (see {s223:isConnectionPointOf}).
e0af2845e17c376cee0a0e8055d2fa4d9cd479ad.label: has connection point
e0af2845e17c376cee0a0e8055d2fa4d9cd479ad.name: has_connection_point

e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.definition: A `Relation` that associates a control setpoint with the `QuantifiableProperty` indicating the desired value which the control process is trying to maintain.
e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.label: has setpoint
e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.name: has_setpoint

e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.definition: The relation `connectedTo` indicates that connectable things are `connected` with a specific direction of flow. A is `connectedTo` B, means a direction of flow from A to B.  The inverse direction is indicated by `connectedFrom` (see {s223:connectedFrom}).
e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.label: connected to
e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.name: connected_to

f33aba6272b056e836a160b11795a5f6ac0cb2b6.definition: A `Relation` that associates a role with of a piece of `Equipment`, a `Connection`, `ConnectionPoint`, or `System` within a building (e.g., a heating coil might be associated with `Role-Heating`). Possible values are defined in `EnumerationKind-Role` (see {s223:EnumerationKind-Role}).
f33aba6272b056e836a160b11795a5f6ac0cb2b6.label: has role
f33aba6272b056e836a160b11795a5f6ac0cb2b6.name: has_role

f3df7987b6f0beaaf394f22c79da7aed6d79fd8f.definition: The relation `hasMedium` is used to indicate what medium is flowing through the connection (e.g., air, water, electricity). The possible values are defined in `Substance-Medium` (see {s223:Substance-Medium}).
f3df7987b6f0beaaf394f22c79da7aed6d79fd8f.label: has medium
f3df7987b6f0beaaf394f22c79da7aed6d79fd8f.name: medium

f5420e5e5881c7a6318e62a2b85784d67061336e.definition: Associates a piece of equipment or a system with the treatment objective it is intended to achieve. What it does to achieve that is watr:hasProcess.
f5420e5e5881c7a6318e62a2b85784d67061336e.label: has treatment objective
f5420e5e5881c7a6318e62a2b85784d67061336e.name: has_treatment_objective

fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.definition: The `hasTemporalRange` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the start and end times for which data has been recorded.
fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.label: has temporal range
fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.name: has_temporal_range

fb4e1a298e9f16097fe9764021ba4d2cf03adf43.definition: The relation `hasMedium` is used to indicate what medium is flowing through the connection (e.g., air, water, electricity). The possible values are defined in `Substance-Medium` (see {s223:Substance-Medium}).
fb4e1a298e9f16097fe9764021ba4d2cf03adf43.label: has medium
fb4e1a298e9f16097fe9764021ba4d2cf03adf43.name: medium

fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.definition: The `hasNumericResolution` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the smallest distinguishable difference between two measured values in engineering units.
fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.label: has numeric resolution
fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.name: has_numeric_resolution
